run_conformance_test: run the protobuf conformance test runner that reads serialized requests from stdin and writes responses to stdout
test_do_test: test the do_test function that parses protobuf JSON or text payloads and serializes to a requested output format
test_do_test_io: test the do_test_io function that reads length-prefixed binary messages from stdin and writes responses to stdout
review_ProtocolError: review the ProtocolError custom exception class used for protocol-level errors in the conformance test runner
refactor_do_test: refactor the do_test function to support additional payload types or output formats beyond protobuf JSON and text
